description: For 40 of the 51 smsg_sound_2 rows the class comes from link order, not from a caller or a vtable: these bodies are dead (no caller, no stored pointer). The nearest class-carrying named functions below and above them carry the same class of ours, and VC6 lays out one object file's functions contiguously. This puts the body in the object file that holds that class's methods, not necessarily in the class: one .cpp can define several classes.
path to resolution: Where a dead body reads a this field that a live method of the class also reads at the same offset, cite it as a second pin; otherwise keep the rows as dead-code names (C2 end state dead).

description: DsBuffer::setnumchannels (dead) accepts only 0 and 1 (0x1000f413..0x1000f41a). setsamplesize stores channels * bits into +0xb4 with no division by 8 (0x1000f3b3). Neither value is a WAVEFORMATEX nChannels / nBlockAlign as Windows defines them. Nothing calls either function, so no run shows what the fields hold.
path to resolution: Read the live writers of +0xaa / +0xb4 (DsBuffer::initDesc 0x1000f590 and its callers) to see which values the live path stores.

description: The MultiSound row 0x10039ca0 (SMSG CWaveMgr::free_all) was rejected. It calls slots 8 and 5 of the head of g_activeListHead 0x100b5070 until the head is NULL. Which vtables the members of that list carry, and so what slot 5 does, was not determined.
path to resolution: List the installers of the objects linked by unlinkFromActiveList 0x1002b090 and read slot 5 of each of their tables.

description: The noun `GT_request` in Midi_Device::post_GT_request / Wave_Device::post_GT_request is SMSG's. Our evidence covers the verb (both post message 0x7ef / 0x7ee) but not what the request record [arg + 4] is.
path to resolution: Read the handlers of messages 0x7ee / 0x7ef in the sound thread's window procedure.

description: Seq::reload is pinned by its neighbours Seq::loadFile 0x10020290 above and Sound5b6a8_dtor 0x1001ff50 below. Sound5b6a8 is our placeholder for the class of vtable 0x1005b6a8, whose slots smsg_sound_1 names Seq::. That makes the two prefixes one class only through smsg_sound_1's rows; neighbours.py itself reads them as different classes.
path to resolution: Rename the placeholder Sound5b6a8 family to Seq (or record the equivalence in classmap.py) and re-run neighbours.py.
